brainlife.desc: PyTorch network weights (.npz) with hyperparameters, currently from TractSeg training, for tract segmentation.
brainlife.name: model/pytorch-weights

original.desc: pytorch weights(.npz) generated by tractseg (for now)

brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Segmenting tracts with weights from the TractSeg training App.

**Not for:** Data whose CSD peaks differ from the training data in space or resolution.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 5 (model-associated) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 1 App, output of 1 App.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/model.pytorch-weights.json

identifying_risks: Weights may retain information about the training subjects.
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 7: model weights trained on human neurodata are model-associated (Tier 5).
sharing_cautions: Record training data and consent terms before sharing.
tier_conditions: Tier 5 while trained on human diffusion MRI.

intended_use: Segmenting tracts with weights from the TractSeg training App.
not_suitable_for: Data whose CSD peaks differ from the training data in space or resolution.

outputs_of.name: TractSeg training
outputs_of.purpose: TractSeg weights trained on peaks and tract masks
